name: chatgpt-agent
description: Delegate review, planning and implementation to the ChatGPT web UI from Claude Code. ChatGPT reads the repo itself over a local bridge, so the diff never enters Claude's context and the reasoning is billed to web-chat quota. Read-only by default; --allow-shell runs commands; --write lets it edit, test and commit the workspace. macOS and Microsoft Edge only; one run at a time.
